crossRefs.note: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.
